words.gloss_range: fixed copular negation of being or existence in the present clause
words.root_gloss_range: local fixed negator branch is active; unrelated lexical branches for bravery, heaviness, or weak judgment are not locally selected
words.prose: {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) opens the ayah by making non-existence the governing frame before the referent or denied agent appears. Its past-shaped but frozen form gives a present, copular denial rather than a developing event: the clause is not saying that a remover has failed to act, but that no qualifying remover exists. Because the negator governs the fronted concern phrase, the divine-boundary phrase, and the delayed final subject, the whole sentence becomes a total restriction of non-divine uncovering or removal. The word also reprises a broader negation-plus-divine-boundary pattern, while the local syntax keeps that echo subordinate to the actual clause architecture. Its opening sibilant lightly answers the final sh-f friction of the remover noun, so sound brackets the ayah between denial and the denied uncovering-agent without carrying the main argument.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) as the opening defective fixed verb of the negative copular clause.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that negation, concern phrase, exclusion phrase, and delayed agent noun work together to exclude every non-divine candidate.

words.gloss_range: preposition of concern or relation governing the attached pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) does not add a detachable possession note; it governs the following pronoun and turns the prior event into the thing concerning which the denial is made. The compact prepositional phrase is fronted before the final subject, so the reader first receives the topic, then the exclusion boundary, and only then the denied remover. Its range includes possession and association, but the local payoff is a dative-of-concern frame: with regard to that approaching event, no remover is available apart from God.

words.prose: {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) is the small form that forces the ayah to look back across the verse boundary. Its feminine singular shape resumes the approaching event from 53:57, so 53:58 is not a fresh independent statement but a dependent comment on that event. The pronoun is broad enough to resonate with the Hour, the Resurrection, and the Occurrence as feminine eschatological terms, but the local attachment evidence resolves the actual reference to 53:57. Because it is bound inside the fronted concern phrase, the sentence keeps the antecedent in memory while delaying the final denied subject.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the exclusion layer inside the negated clause. Its ordinary separation or source range is locally narrowed by the following boundary noun, so the phrase works as apart-from restriction rather than a loose source phrase. Placed after the concern phrase and before the final subject, it pivots the reader from the event to the field of possible agents and narrows that field before the remover noun is even named. The construction supplies restriction through a prepositional route rather than an explicit exception particle, and its frequent formulaic use, reported as 109 occurrences for the exact phrase, strengthens the divine-exclusivity payoff. The nasal sound-link remains a secondary recitational support, binding the function word to the boundary noun as one heard unit.

words.root_gloss_range: locally active branch is below/besides as an exclusion boundary; registry and bureau derivatives are background pressure only
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) is the boundary noun that receives the preceding preposition and then governs the divine name in construct. That double dependency makes the exclusion grammatical, not decorative: the field below or apart from God is closed before the final remover noun arrives. The root's spatial sense of below gives the apartness a hierarchy, so rival agency is not merely elsewhere but beneath the divine boundary. The derivative register family can color the boundary as an ordered field under accounting, but the local sense remains below/besides rather than record-keeping. Its abstract-noun and construct shape make exclusion a named boundary rather than a loose adverb, and the repeated nasal across the particle and noun audibly seals that compact phrase. In the clause order, this word turns the sentence from the event toward the authority boundary that controls the denied removal, carrying a familiar divine-exclusivity formula used for worship, aid, protection, and authority into the specific field of removal.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) completes the exclusion phrase as a genitive complement, so the divine name is the boundary by which the denial is measured, not the final denied subject. Its proper-name definiteness and fused written form prevent the phrase from meaning some generic deity-domain; the exclusion is anchored in God specifically as a fixed proper-name boundary. The root-family and derivational dispute can add pressure of worship, dependence, and bewilderment at the point where no remover exists, but local grammar keeps the word as the proper divine name. Its position immediately before the final remover noun makes the divine boundary the last named pole before the denied agent-class appears, and same-surah recurrence such as 53:25 lets ownership of the ends sharpen control over what cannot be averted. The name also functions as the shared pole of the negation, boundary, and uncovering-removal pairings, stabilizing the closing-section thread across 53:23, 53:25, 53:31, 53:58, and 53:62. In recitation, the construct bond is heard as joined, so the boundary noun and divine name arrive as one phrase while grammar supplies the main force.

words.gloss_range: active participle naming an uncoverer, revealer, remover, or single removal-instance, locally denied under the preceding negation
words.root_gloss_range: core root image is uncovering or removing a covering; local context selects averting/removal of the approaching event while retaining the image of disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:كَاشِفَةٌ}} ({{tr:kāshifatun}}) is the final word that resolves the long negated sentence. As an active participle in the subject slot, it names a possible remover or uncoverer only to have that class denied by the opening negator; the indefinite ending makes the denial range over any such agent or instance. Its feminine form agrees with the prior eschatological referent and can intensify the sense toward not even one removal-instance, but it does not make the subject a separate female agent. The surface chooses an agent noun rather than causative, reflexive, discovery, or gradual uncovering routes, and that marked active-participle choice shifts attention from an action to the nonexistence of an agent. The root keeps both revealing and removing in play: the approaching event calls especially for averting or lifting away, while the uncovering image keeps disclosure in view. Cross-surah divine-only removal patterns such as 6:17 and 10:107 stand behind the word, but here the syntax turns that pattern into the absence of any rival remover. Variant evidence that pairs uncovering with an overwhelming covering sharpens the reveal/conceal contrast, and an expanded consequence-clause variant shows how the line could continue, while the canonical wording closes on this denied remover. The nearby doubt setting in 53:55 and the feminine participial echo with the approaching event in 53:57 make the final word a local theological answer: what draws near cannot be removed by any rival. The final placement makes the root image attempt an opening just as the clause closes every non-divine route, and the back-stop-to-sibilance-to-lip-release sound contour remains a secondary enactment of emergence blocked by syntax.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The full construction لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ combines categorical negation, excluded alternatives, and an agent of kashf.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause empties every non-divine position of an effective agent able to remove a cover or lift harm, while retaining Allah as the sole pole of such agency.

activation_trace.role: Categorical negation clears the clause's field of effective alternative agents.
The other-than or besides branch makes every non-divine candidate an excluded alternative.
The worshipped-one branch identifies Allah as the sole retained pole of agency.
Removing a cover and lifting harm supplies the concrete action denied to every excluded agent.

changed_reading.before: No one except Allah can remove it.
changed_reading.after: The clause does not merely predict failed removal; it empties every non-divine rank of an effective remover while reserving cover-lifting and relief to Allah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَاشِفَةٌ can name exposure or emergence as well as removal, while لَهَا leaves the feminine referent open.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kashf can move a concealed referent into manifestation. The same negative construction therefore withholds not only rescue but also autonomous disclosure from every agent besides Allah.

activation_trace.role: Emergence and exposure make manifestation, not only relief, a live function of the agent noun.
Present-state denial withholds a currently available discloser.
Besides or other than excludes rival sources of decisive disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse only denies an outside rescuer for an unnamed crisis.
changed_reading.after: It can also deny every outside discloser: no one apart from Allah can make the concealed 'it' emerge or become decisively exposed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ places the denied field in relation to Allah rather than merely listing a second party.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nearness-yet-short-of-a-limit branch spatializes agency. Candidate powers may be near, available, or lower in rank, but none reaches the terminal capacity named by kashf.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains below or short of a limit turns exclusion into a graded hierarchy.
The divine object of worship marks the hierarchy's upper and final term.
Lifting the cover or harm is the limit lower agencies fail to reach.

changed_reading.before: Besides Allah is a flat either-or exclusion.
changed_reading.after: The phrase also pictures a hierarchy of near or subordinate powers that all stop short of effective kashf.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overturning and falling issue in an enveloping cover, followed by compressed nearness. Kashf supplies the exact counter-motion, but the negation denies that any lower agency can peel back, reverse, or relieve what is arriving.

activation_trace.role: Cover-removal and relief provide the counter-motion blocked by the clause.
Lower powers remain short of the point where reversal would become effective.
Falling into a depth gives the catastrophe a forceful downward trajectory.
An enveloping cover makes the event itself a totalizing act of concealment.
Turning a thing away from its orientation supplies the prior inversion that kashf would have to undo.
Doubled nearness removes the temporal room in which a lower counterforce might be imagined.

structural_cues: 53:53-58 sequences overturning and fall, enveloping cover, warning, doubled imminence, and then negated kashf.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies downward inversion, covering, nearness, and cover-removal; I infer that kashf is their counter-motion. A live alternative is that kashf lifts resulting distress without physically reversing the event.

changed_reading.before: No one but Allah can remove an approaching event.
changed_reading.after: The arriving catastrophe is an overturning cover whose motion no lower power can reverse or peel back; only Allah stands beyond that blocked counter-motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier vision sequence distinguishes hidden imparting, knowledge as uncovering, reliable seeing, and a cover that does not erase perception. Against that sequence, كَاشِفَةٌ can denote the authorized disclosure of the approaching referent, not only its removal.

activation_trace.role: Exposure after concealment anchors the focus clause in an epistemic mechanism.
Present-state denial bars an independently available revealer.
Knowledge cast secretly supplies a concealed channel whose disclosure is controlled.
A thing becoming uncovered to a knower directly bridges knowledge and kashf.
Vision by eye and insight supplies the receiving side of controlled manifestation.
A cover over the seen object sharpens the contrast between concealment and authorized sight.

structural_cues: 53:4-18 moves from hidden imparting through seeing to sight that does not deviate even while a cover descends.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden communication, epistemic uncovering, sight, and covering; I infer that their sequence activates disclosure in كَاشِفَةٌ. Lifting harm or averting the event remains equally live.

changed_reading.before: كَاشِفَةٌ is only an agent who averts disaster.
changed_reading.after: It can also be the decisive revealer of the concealed event or its reality, with disclosure monopolized by Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first removes compelling warrant from fabricated substitutes, then depicts intercession as an added party that cannot suffice unless permission is granted. مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ therefore denies autonomous kashf throughout a dependency hierarchy, not merely one rival deity.

activation_trace.role: Besides and lower in rank define the field of purported intermediaries.
The worshipped one remains the final source against which all substitute objects are measured.
Actual relief is the efficacy no intermediary possesses independently.
Compelling proof supplies the warrant that named substitutes conspicuously lack.
An advocate joining another supplies the context's explicit model of mediation.
Sufficiency names precisely what the mediating act fails to achieve on its own.
Permission makes any lower efficacy licensed and derivative rather than autonomous.

structural_cues: 53:23-28 strips named substitutes of authority and makes even angelic intercession ineffective before permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unwarranted substitutes, joined advocacy, insufficiency, and permission; I infer that this dependency architecture governs the later kashf claim. The alternative is a stricter reading that excludes every intermediary even when licensed.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects a set of rival rescuers.
changed_reading.after: It rejects autonomous rescue at every subordinate level: any imagined intermediary is insufficient, and any real efficacy would remain permission-dependent rather than outside Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense turns action into an answering return; burdens do not transfer; each person has only acquired striving; and repayment becomes complete. Within that mechanism, kashf is not just escape from impact but removal of a due account that no proxy can carry or settle.

activation_trace.role: Lifting harm supplies the sought discharge from the consequence-bearing account.
Every other party is excluded as an alternate bearer or settler.
Action answered by its recompense establishes the context's accounting mechanism.
A heavy carried burden makes non-transferability materially concrete.
The repeated present-state negation links the focus denial to personal acquisition.
Work and acquisition tie the coming result to the person's own earned motion.
Completion without deficiency closes the possibility of an under-settled account.

structural_cues: 53:31-41 runs from recompense through non-transferable burden and personal striving to full repayment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, burden, non-transfer, acquisition, and completion; I infer that these legal-economic relations specify what cannot be lifted by proxy. The physical or epistemic event reading remains independent.

changed_reading.before: No outside savior can remove a crisis.
changed_reading.after: No alternate bearer, proxy, or payment can lift the fully answerable account; its disclosure and consequence terminate with Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: A repeated single subject produces opposed affective states, removes life-force, and originates a second arising. The focus negation is thus the negative face of a positive causal pattern: the same actor who crosses all prior state-boundaries alone controls the final exposure or relief.

activation_trace.role: Allah is the named endpoint of the repeated exclusive subject pattern.
Changing covered distress into exposure or relief becomes another controlled state-transition.
The face opening into visible laughter supplies one pole of a divinely caused reversal.
Grief, tears, and voice supply the paired opposite state under the same subject.
Removing force and life broadens the sequence from affective to existential transition.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the forward transition of the second origination.

structural_cues: 53:43-49 repeats an emphatic single subject across paired and irreversible state changes before 53:58 names Allah explicitly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired effects, death, origination, and repeated subject grammar; I infer that kashf joins this causal series. A live alternative restricts كَاشِفَةٌ to knowledge of the event rather than execution of a transition.

changed_reading.before: The clause is a bare denial of creaturely capacity.
changed_reading.after: It is also the culmination of a positive causal monopoly: the one who repeatedly moves creation across opposites alone governs the final unveiling or relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: Historical destruction falls into no remainder, then total covering; warning wakes caution, but doubled imminence collapses delay. The focus clause seals that sequence by denying any reprieve-producing remover below Allah.

activation_trace.role: Categorical negation closes the sequence rather than leaving a residual exception.
Lifting distress names the reprieve historical precedent has just withdrawn.
Falling into destruction provides a realized precedent rather than a hypothetical threat.
The sparing branch, under explicit negation, removes preservation and reprieve from the precedent.
General enveloping turns destruction into total coverage rather than a partial strike.
Fear-producing warning opens a last interval for caution, not an alternate remover.
Haste and urgency close the warning interval immediately before the focus denial.

structural_cues: 53:50-58 moves from completed precedents through no remainder, total covering, warning, and imminence to the denial of a remover.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies realized destruction, non-sparing, coverage, warning, and urgency; I infer that these operate as precedent for the feminine referent in لَهَا. The referent could instead remain specifically the event's timing or disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse states an abstract doctrine of sole divine power.
changed_reading.after: It is the no-reprieve seal on an evidentiary sequence: prior coverings left no remainder, the warning interval is closing, and no lower agent can reopen it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once alternative kashf is denied, renewed news is met by self-enlarging surprise, visible amusement, and the raised head; the closing command reverses that posture into bodily lowering. The focus clause becomes a hinge from futile affective distancing to submission.

activation_trace.role: Lower-than and short-of-a-limit becomes the spatial relation the body must acknowledge.
The impossibility of self-produced relief removes avoidance as an effective response.
News renewed in speech makes the warning present as an address demanding response.
Self-magnification makes astonishment a posture of distance rather than receptivity.
Joy or astonishment displayed as laughter externalizes dismissive affect.
Raising the head and standing gives dismissal a vertical bodily form.
Bowing the head reverses the raised posture and enacts acknowledged dependence.

structural_cues: 53:58 is followed immediately by astonishment, laughter, a raised-head state, and finally commanded prostration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed relief followed by opposed affective and bodily postures; I infer that 53:58 causally pivots the sequence toward lowering. The command can also answer the whole surah rather than this clause alone.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely reports that no alternative remover exists.
changed_reading.after: It strips astonishment, laughter, and raised-headed distance of efficacy, then redirects the body downward toward the only named locus of kashf.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch is a technical camel-breeding use far from the ordinary agent noun, but it remains anchored in ك ش ف and is reinforced by adjacent seminal, formative, and pregnancy branches. Render it only as a cross-domain material analogy, never as a lexical replacement for كَاشِفَةٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reproductive side-branch of ك ش ف permits the feminine كَاشِفَةٌ to resonate with the immediately prior sequence of seed, formation, and second arising.

activation_trace.role: The disputed camel mating, pregnancy, or post-birth term opens a reproductive material register for kashf.
Clear fluid ranging from a drop to semen supplies the initial material of emergence.
Seminal matter from which form is measured supplies the formative stage.
Conception and growth of pregnancy complete the adjacent gestational analogy.

changed_reading.before: The approaching event is only a disaster to avert or a secret to reveal.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also resembles a second gestation reaching emergence, whose bringing-forth is not held by any lower agent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shieldless-body and open-hostility branches are side senses, so a martial gloss would overstate them. They remain valid activators because both attach directly to focus ك ش ف and meet contextual force and resistance branches. Render the result as an exploratory exposure metaphor, not as the verse's resolved military sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Two focus branches of ك ش ف combine bodily exposure without a shield and open confrontation.

activation_trace.role: A shieldless exposed condition turns failed kashf into vulnerability before the event.
Openly initiating confrontation supplies the attempted but unavailable counter-stance.
Lower powers define the exposed field that falls short of effective resistance.
Overpowering force supplies the contextual measure against which lower claimants fail.
Resistance and contest make confrontation a coherent, though branch-distant, mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No lower power can remove the event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, every lower claimant stands exposed and shieldless, unable to meet the event in an effective open confrontation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The register branch belongs to the lexical orbit of diwans and is remote from the prepositional use of دُونِ, so it must not become a translation. It remains worth carrying because the focus root, written sheets, debt collection, complete settlement, and exposure form a traceable administrative analogy. Render it only as a secondary accountability resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The register side-branch of د و ن intersects focus exposure with the surah's written and fully settled account.

activation_trace.role: Recording in registers opens an administrative side-image within the focus root.
Exposure gives the imagined register a decisive disclosure function.
A written sheet supplies the context's explicit documentary medium.
Collecting and satisfying a debt turns documentation toward settlement.
Full completion closes the account without a deficit left for another office.

changed_reading.before: The clause excludes only rival rescuers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, no subordinate register can issue the decisive disclosure or settlement; the account terminates with Allah.

strongest_changes: كَاشِفَةٌ bifurcated into avertive cover-lifting and epistemic manifestation, and the context kept both live.
Intercession and permission turned مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ into a dependency hierarchy rather than only a list of rivals.
Recompense and non-transferable burden recast removal as the impossibility of offloading a fully answerable account.
The destruction-to-prostration sequence turned the clause into a hinge from failed avoidance and raised-headed distance to embodied lowering.
summary.what_was_special: One focus agent noun sustained causal, epistemic, legal, spatial, affective, and ritual mechanisms without forcing a single winner; branch-distant material also yielded contained gestational, martial, and register readings that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: لَهَا may point to the approaching event, its onset, its harm, or its concealed knowledge, and the packet does not force one target.
كَاشِفَةٌ may name an averter, revealer, or manifestation; the causal and epistemic readings can coexist but should not be silently merged.
The permission sequence leaves open whether licensed derivative agency is compatible with the focus denial or whether all intermediary language is excluded there.
The gestational, martial, and register outliers depend on side branches and must remain analogical rather than lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **No one besides God can remove its cover or distress.** ل ي س B001 supplies categorical negation; د و ن B003 supplies other than/besides; ك ش ف B001 removing a cover and lifting harm. The approaching event is the pronoun's antecedent. I infer that no secondary agency can reverse or relieve it; the ayah reads as exclusive causal control.
2. **No lower or nearer substitute can disclose it.** د و ن B001 supplies what is lower/nearer but short of a limit; ك ش ف B002 supplies emergence or exposure. I infer that proximate authorities and visible means cannot make the event appear on demand. The ayah preserves “revealer” alongside “remover.”
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:59 names the warning a report and asks about wonder, showing one function of ك ش ف B002: the discourse discloses the approaching event even though no independent agent controls its exposure or removal.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The same authority controls both cover-removal and disclosure.** `ل ي س B001` supplies fixed negation, `د و ن B003` other than or besides, and `ك ش ف B001` removing a cover, with `ك ش ف B002` emergence or exposure. The nearby event was covered in 53:54 and announced as approaching in 53:57. The packet supplies cover, nearness, and exclusive unveiling; I infer the arrow authority over concealment -> authority over disclosure or removal. The fixed `كاشفة` can therefore mean both no alternative remover of the event and no alternative revealer who can expose it.

2. **A lesser, near-at-hand intermediary cannot bridge the limit.** `د و ن B001` supplies nearness short of a limit. Set beside the approaching event, that branch makes `من دون الله` not only “besides” but any subordinate agency that remains short of ultimate capacity. The packet supplies a near limit, subordinate position, and negated unveiling; I infer the arrow lesser proximity -/-> terminal control. The ayah blocks the assumption that a nearer intermediary is therefore an effective one.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bu kullanımda ardından gelen öğenin dışarıda bırakıldığını ve belirtme durumunda bulunduğunu açıkça belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bu özel istisna işlevini yüklemli olumsuzluktan doğru biçimde ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca insanın yumuşak huylu oluşunu ve görmezden gelmesini değil, devenin yüklenen her şeyi taşımasını da içerir. Dal korunabilir, ancak fiziksel yük taşıma ile insandaki güçlüğe katlanma ve hoşgörülü davranma aynı üst dayanma ilişkisine bağlı farklı gerçekleşimler olarak ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Fiziksel yük taşıma, insanda güçlüğe katlanma, yumuşak huyluluk ve görmezden gelme birlikte kapsanır; bunlar yerinde kalma veya savaşçı cesareti değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Devenin yük taşıması temel fiziksel gerçekleşim, insandaki katlanma ile görmezden gelme ise kendi yapılara bağlı insani gerçekleşimler olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Yüklenen şeyi taşıma çekirdeğinden, kişinin güçlüğe katlanıp yumuşak huylu davranmasına ve rahatsız edici bir şeyi görmezden gelerek aşmasına uzanan kullanımları kapsar.

facets.statement: Devenin üzerine yüklenen her şeyi taşıyabilmesini belirtir.

Rahatsız edici bir şeyi görmezden gelip üzerinde durmamayı belirtir.
Yumuşak huylu kişiyi niteleyen özel bir söz öbeğinde kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt fiziksel yük taşıma ile insanın güçlüğe katlanması, yumuşak huylu olması ve bir şeyi görmezden gelmesi arasında uzanan bir anlam alanı verir; ayrıntılar tek kaynaklara bölünebilecek ayrı iddialar halinde sunulmamıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yakınlık ve yaklaşmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; bunun yanında bir üst sınırın altında kalmayı, hedefe erişememeyi ve belirli bir seslenişte yaklaşma buyruğunu da içerir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak yalnızca mekansal yakınlık ya da yalnızca hedefe ulaşamama diye daraltılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin ilişkisel anlamları ile iki kalıba bağlı kullanım ayrı tutulur; kalıplardaki yaklaşma anlamı yalın biçimin tamamına genellenmez.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın başka bir varlığa göre daha yakın olması ya da ona yaklaşması temel ilişkidir.
İlişki, yukarının karşıtı olarak aşağıda kalmayı veya hedeflenen sona erişememeyi gösterebilir.
Belirli bir hitap kalıbı, muhataba yaklaşmasını bildiren bir buyruk kurar.

concept_map.definition: Dişi devenin çiftleştirilme ve yavrulama zamanlamasıyla ilgili, kaynaklarda sınırları tartışmalı bir teknik kullanımdır. facets.statement: Ortak alan, dişi devenin çiftleştirilme, gebe kalma ve yavrulama zamanlarının düzenlenmesine ilişkin teknik adlandırmadır.

Başka bir açıklama dişi devenin iki veya üç yıl boyunca çiftleştirilmeden bırakılmasını belirtir.
Bir açıklama gebe dişi devenin erkek deveyle çiftleştirilmesini verir, fakat başka bir aktarım bu açıklamayı yanlış sayar.
Diğer bir açıklama, dişi devenin doğumdan çok kısa süre sonra yeniden çiftleştirilmesini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar tek bir tanımda birleşmez: peş peşe yavrulama veya yıllarda ardışık çiftleştirme, birkaç yıl çiftleştirmeme, doğumdan hemen sonra yeniden çiftleştirme ve gebe iken çiftleştirme açıklamaları yan yana verilir. word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
